title: netscaler: clean up the way we read pages.
description:
It appears that the last page of a file can be shorter than the regular
page size.  Rename nstrace_read_buf() to nstrace_read_page(), and have
it succeed on a short read - only an I/O error or an EOF should cause it
to fail - and have it set nstrace->nstrace_buflen to the number of bytes
it read.

Have the private data structure contain the page size.

Clean up some other stuff.
